name: verifier-cash-workspace
description: Local harness for measuring/optimizing the Groth16-on-BCH verifier (verifier.cash). Provides libauth (BCH-2026 VM) + noble curves so the groth16_cashscript graders run on Linux.

scripts.check: node packages/cli/src/with-lease.mjs repository-check -- npm run check:serial
scripts.check:serial: npm run check:paths && npm run check:architecture && npm run check:frontiers && npm run check:catalogue && npm run check:harness && npm run check:build
scripts.check:architecture: node --test lanes/*/test/*.test.mjs packages/contracts/test/*.test.mjs packages/cli/test/*.test.mjs && node packages/cli/src/check-architecture.mjs
